newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs seen vulnerable to French election worry.
newsitem.headline: OLOs seen vulnerable to French election worry.

text.p: New concern that a Socialist French government would take an anti-EMU stance after Sunday's election pushed Belgian bond futures to a lower close on Wednesday, along with several other small European debt markets.
Dealers said that with Germany closed on Thursday and in the absence of major U.S. or German indicators the rest of the week, the market's full attention would go to the French election.

One added that a weak chart outlook, with both OLOs and Bund futures unable to revisit the support lines of former upchannels, added to the worry. OLO futures closed 16 bp lower at 120.26 after rising to 120.72 in early trade.
Dealer said that new weakness of the French franc could spill over on the Belgian franc, which would in turn further push up short-term yields and eventually bond yields if that situation persisted.
Earlier today, the Belgian Treasury said Wednesday it would offer to exchange OLO lines 254 and 248 for OLOs 287, 259, 275 and 286 at the June 10 exchange auction.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
